title: RARE DROPS SEND UP A BEAM
why: His order of 2026-10-12, the graphics program (item 14). A pile whose contents are known (dropped, or opened with something left in it) and whose best item is rare or better now sends up a soft column of light in its rarity colour, so a good drop reads from across the street the way it does in ARC Raiders. Only while you can actually see the pile: the beam is drawn under the fog of war and only for piles in your sight, so it never shows loot through a wall. Unopened boxes never get one (his note of 2026-08-26). Drawing only.
now: Rare and better drops send up a beam in their rarity colour while you can see them.
